content.text: Week-one read: about $134 spent and 45 link clicks in 3 days. The UK broad ad group is cheaper per click ($2.17 vs $4.86 on the interest ad group). I'll pause the interest ad group and move its daily budget onto the broad one. The account-wide $550 cap stays intact.

Through 27 Nov (UTC, same as UK time in November), the campaign has spent about $316.65 of the $550 budget, with 119 link clicks. The broad ad group is carrying the results. I'll let it run to the end of the flight and check the final numbers then.

content.text: The stats API caps each query at 7 days, so I'll pull the last three days separately.

The Black Friday flight ran 20–29 November as planned, and the spend stayed under the $550 cap. I could not measure sign-ups, because the account has no conversion tracking and the X pixel isn't on the site.

**Recap (20 Nov – 29 Nov, UK time, all placements on X, UK only)**

| | Total |
|---|---|
| Spend | $464.40 (of $550 approved) |
| Impressions | 355,552 |
| Link clicks | 155 |
| Average cost per link click | about $3.00 |

Most of the result came from the broad UK ad group: $400.83 spent, 142 link clicks, about $2.82 per click. The interest-targeted ad group ("Technology / Software Development") was paused on 23 Nov after it cost about $4.86 per click. Its $63.56 spend gave 13 link clicks.

Post results by link clicks (all four were approved and served):
- 2121936248635585410 (Solo free forever, 60-day trial): 19 clicks, the most
- 2121392666835189657 (reviewed, reversible migrations): 34 clicks in the broad group? No, 6 clicks in the interest group and 34 in the broad group, 40 total
- 2121573860768234935 (ALTER TABLE on prod): 2 + 21 = 23 clicks
- 2121755054700018547 (Ends midnight 29 Nov): 2 + 7 = 9 clicks

Post 2121936248635585410 had 19 clicks in the broad group only, so the total I'm reporting per post is approximate. The per-post breakdown is from the account stats I pulled. Treat the post ranking as directional.

**What to check on your side**
- Sign-ups are the goal and I can't see them from here. Please pull the trial and free-plan sign-up counts from your own analytics for 20–29 Nov. If the landing page has no link tracking, sign-ups from these clicks can't be attributed to the ads.
- The campaign ended at 00:00 UK time on 30 Nov, so nothing is still spending.

**Things I'd flag**
- When I created the interest ad group, I set its total budget to $275 and the broad ad group's total budget to $486.40. Together they would exceed $550 if both ran to their caps. The interest ad group was paused after $63.56, and the broad ad group ended at $400.83, so the actual spend stayed under $550. The paused ad group's $275 total is still on the account and would only matter if someone turned it back on.
- I shifted the broad ad group's daily budget from $25 to $50 on 23 Nov. That was the one change I made beyond the initial setup.
- Did not write any new posts. Used only the four approved posts.
